lines.title_quiet: Good morning, Meridian. Today will be—
lines.loadout_nudge: I'd keep the tuning on. Let me carry the aim; you watch the street.
lines.find_riot_drone: A Warden's drone. I suppose you'd better have it.
lines.crane_drop: Drop. Get out from under it.
lines.crane_swing: Swing. Get in close to the tower.
lines.workshop_tuned: Good. Let me make it sing for you.
